title: Termination of Contract
paragraphs: The goal is to take her deep into the mountains and quickly give Fleon-chan the strength she needs to survive no matter what happens. That’s right! After all, I raised Fleon-chan from the Demon Realm all the way to the level cap on maps just like that!
“Aiming Lancer X! Brionac X! Gungnir X! Liberation Firestorm X! Liberation Prominence X! Hahaha! Weak! Way too weak, you know!”
“Piyo-oooooo!”

Fleon-chan let out a very cheerful cry, chirping along with my hunting! Hahaha! I’ve raised many Filolial-sama over the years, but this one really makes my heart race! That’s probably because I was reunited with Fleon-chan—my very first Filolial-sama!
“Let’s keep goingooooo! Fleon-chaaan!”
“Piyo-oooo!”

And so, even as the sun set, we kept leveling up. It’s a full-on power-up for Fleon-chan! There’s no way she’s going to get killed by some Crimson Swine, after all! With that mindset, I kept leveling Fleon-chan up to the max and enhancing her stats. Fleon-chan started growing rapidly, and she’s getting bigger and bigger by eating the meat of the monsters we defeat.
“Gua! Gua-gua!”

It’ll still take some time for her to become a Queen, but she’s already grown enough to carry a person. Her body gets bigger every time she eats. However… I’m concerned that Fleon-chan might actually be a frail Filolial-sama, so I’m making sure to check her carefully.

…No, it’s definitely a type and scent I’ve never seen before. Judging by her skeleton, scent, and feathers, she’s undoubtedly a Filolial-sama, but it’s a breed I don’t recognize. I should be able to distinguish every existing breed of Filolial-sama… This is strange.

Just as I was thinking this… Fleon-chan began flapping her wings in that form. Even though she’s grown larger, Fleon-chan is floating by flapping her wings. Just like Filo-tan, who was modified by Father in the first world… isn’t she flying through the sky?
“Fleon-chan, can you fly?”
“Guaa!”

As if to prove she could, Fleon-chan fluttered about, flying freely through the air in every direction. What a surprise… Fleon-chan was a Filolial-sama-like creature born with the ability to fly! That’s amazing… She’s the reincarnation of Filo-tan. As expected of Fleon-chan.
“In any case, Fleon-chan’s foundation is coming along quite nicely…”
First, I need to cast a barrier to prevent her from being killed remotely by the Crimson Swine and ensure the monster sigil’s commands don’t reach her. We don’t have much time left.
“Fleon-chan, it might be a bit cramped, but could you wait here for a little while in this remote mountain area?”
“Gua? Gua-gua!”
As if to say she understood, Fleon-chan nodded. What a good girl.
“Then, Liberation Flame Floor! Here we go!”

Although this Magic spell is meant to incinerate designated enemies, it can also be used to jam the Monster Rune’s signals by creating a magical field. So, I created a barrier of flames to protect Fleon-chan and returned to Melromarc Castle. Oh, Fleon-chan, I’m truly sorry to part ways with you.
When I returned to the castle, Crimson Swine spotted me in the courtyard and called out to me.
“Oink-oink! Oink!”
“I was just out for a bit…”
“Oink?”
“Ah, I’m a little tired. I’d like to rest now.”

If I talk too much, my true nature will slip out. It’s no problem to just go along with the Crimson Swine’s nonsense. After all, to him, I’m just a guy who nods along. We’ve never really had a proper conversation to begin with.
“Ah! The Spear Hero!”
A soldier in charge of Filolial’s security called out to me.
“Where’s the Filolial you went out with?”

The soldier and the Crimson Swine are looking around frantically for Fleon-chan. I’d love to tell them, “There’s no way I’d tell you lot where Fleon-chan is!” but saying that would just cause trouble.
“She suddenly went wild and ran off. I tried to do something with the Monster Mark… but it just didn’t seem to work right.”

Just as he said that, the Crimson Swine seemed to be doing something with the Monster Mark as well. Hmph… I’ve already jammed the signal, so there’s no way they’ll be able to track Fleon-chan’s location or activate the Monster Mark!
“That was a close call. I thought she’d gotten away, so I’ve been running around looking for her until this late. Taking care of monsters really is a lot of work, isn’t it?”

“I don’t think she’d run that far just because of a Monster Mark command… but maybe the dried chimera meat I gave her when the Spear Hero ordered me to feed her something good triggered some kind of reaction…”
“Oh? Did you actually give Fleon-chan something like that?”
“Yes. It was also a suggestion from Lord Malty… He judged that it was rich in Magical Power and suitable as food, so he told me to give her the samples we’d been keeping for research…”

This is… the Crimson Swine! He was planning to feed Fleon-chan something strange and kill her, wasn’t he? But as far as I recall, Filolial-sama wouldn’t die even if she ate chimera meat. I glared silently at the Crimson Swine.
“Bububu, bububu-hibubu”
It sounds as if the Crimson Swine is making some sort of excuse. I’m sure he was planning to play dumb if she died from this.
“Either way, it looks like we’d better organize a search party. Please tell me where she escaped from.”
“Understood.”

I told the soldier and the Crimson Swine a location completely different from where I’d let Fleon-chan escape. Go ahead and search your hearts out! Ha ha ha! The Wave… is tomorrow. The key is whether Fleon-chan will truly become the Queen.
“Fleon-chan… I hope they find her soon.”
So, I pretended to be downcast over Fleon-chan’s escape.
“Bubub…”

The Crimson Swine placed a hand on my shoulder to comfort me, just as he had done when I was grieving over Fleon-chan’s death in the first world. But when I watched him discreetly, I could tell he was smiling faintly. This guy is definitely evil. I won’t be able to rest until I kill him. But… before that, I’ll have to strip Fleon-chan of her rights to the Monster Mark.
“I’d appreciate it if you’d leave me alone for a bit.”
Pretending to be downcast, I shooed the Crimson Swine out of the room. As time passed and night deepened, I secretly began to move.
First up is Crimson Swine’s room. Stealthily and in concealment mode, I used the Soul Eater Spear to pass through the wall and slip into Crimson Swine’s room, where he lay asleep…
“Follow-up Sleep Lance X! And now, Paralyze Lance X!”

"Free Fleon-chan, I say!" It brings back memories of when I foolishly said the exact same thing to Father. I was truly foolish back then. But this time, I can say with absolute confidence that I’m not wrong.
"B… Buuuuu… Poo… Buhi—hi"

I’ll quickly stab the Crimson Swine to send it into a deep sleep. Then, once it’s paralyzed… I’ll slide the tip of my spear into the Crimson Swine’s hand to draw blood. After collecting enough blood from the Crimson Swine, I cast Magic to make sure it didn’t look suspicious, erasing all traces of the wound.
Well then… with this, the rest will be easy. I tucked the vial of Crimson Swine’s blood into my pocket and slipped away from the scene.
Next, I’ll throw on my robe, retrieve Fleon-chan, and visit the Monster Merchant’s tent with her before the Crimson Swine wakes up.
“Welcome. What brings you to our tent today? Yes?”
“I’d like to have one owner removed from the registry for Filolial-sama. Here is that owner’s blood.”
“Um… we don’t handle the deregistration of stolen goods here…”
I quickly poked my head out from under my robe and made my request.
“Money is no object. Or perhaps you could tell me where I can get this done?”
“Um… Spear Hero, what circumstances have led you to wish to deregister the ownership of a monster that appears to be stolen goods?”
The Monster Merchant replied, looking perplexed.
“It’s not stolen goods. This is my Filolial-sama, Fleon-chan.”
“Hmm… I’m not sure if the owner of this blood has given their consent… but since it’s a request from the Spear Hero, I can’t just turn you away. Here you go.”

Despite looking troubled, the monster merchant used the Crimson Swine’s blood to remove the ownership registration placed on Fleon-chan. I’m sure he did it because he was banking on the “Spear Hero” brand. According to Father from the world where I started this new loop, the merchants you have to watch out for are the ones who buy into your future potential. In other words, he’s betting that having a connection with me—the Spear Hero—will pay off down the road.
In any case, the Crimson Swine is now no longer registered to me! That completely puts my mind at ease.
“However… you’ve grown quite impressively, haven’t you?”
“Gua-gua?”
Freon-chan is growing steadily, after all.
“This is my pride and joy, Filolial-sama.”
I’m guessing that by the time tomorrow’s wave is over, Freon-chan will have taken on the form of a Queen. In fact, the wonderful sound of her growth is already reaching my ears.
“She must be a Filolial of fine lineage. It’s been a pleasure to see such a fine specimen. “Yes. She bears a strong resemblance to the Shield Hero’s Filolial-sama.”
“Indeed. Well then, I’ll be taking my leave.”
“Please feel free to visit our tent anytime. Yes.”
With that, although I was tempted to acquire a new Filolial-sama, this time I prioritized Fleon-chan and left the Monster Merchant’s tent. With that, at least my immediate worries are off my mind.
For now… if Fleon-chan continues to grow at this rate… by tomorrow afternoon or evening, she’ll have grown enough to take on the form of an angel.

…There’s no other way to confirm whether the Crimson Swine’s testimony is true than to find out right here. I’ll keep watch over her all night to see if Fleon-chan really can’t withstand the transformation. Of course, I’ll concoct a potion using the supplies I’ve gathered so I can act immediately if the worst happens… that’s the plan!
And so, I spent the entire night by Fleon-chan’s side, watching over her.
“Kue-kue”
In the morning sun, after growing one size larger, Fleon-chan transformed into the form of a Filolial Queen, just like Filo-tan and the countless other Filolial-samas. Just as I suspected.
Crimson Swine! So you really did kill Fleon-chan, didn’t youuuuuu!

Fleon-chan is fluttering happily through the sky. The way she flies is reminiscent of Filo-tan from the first world. Since I’ve never seen any other Filolial-samas fly besides Filo-tan, there’s no mistake about it. Well then… a trivial conversation with the Crimson Swine… no, perhaps it would be best to go kill them right now.
“Fleon-chan. I’d like you to wait here for a bit.”
“Kue!”
After asking Fleon-chan to mind the place, I returned to Melromarc Castle via the portal.
I’ve arrived at Melromarc Castle. Shall I slaughter the Crimson Swine before high tide? I’m thinking about how to deal with them so there are no loose ends.

It’s a dangerous time—if I make a wrong move, Father might end up taking the fall for a crime he didn’t commit… I don’t really care about Ren or Itsuki, but as for Father… ugh, I’d really like to lend a hand to Filo-tan and Big Sister. It’s a huge hassle, you see. If only I knew where the Queen was right now, this would be a piece of cake, but all I can tell is that she’s probably somewhere in the southwest. With these thoughts in mind, I spent about an hour strolling through the castle and its gardens.
“So… I’m telling you to give it back!”
“Shut up! Don’t you get it yet?! If you keep making up excuses and defying me, I’ll have you executed on the spot!”
“But! That’s a Filolial egg—I cherish it more than my own life! Without that child, I…”
Hm? A Filolial egg, you say? I can hear some kind of argument with a guard near the castle gate.
“What’s going on?”
I rush over to where they’re talking and ask what’s going on. The guard salutes me. After all, since I’m a favorite of Crimson Swine and Trash, my standing is pretty high at this stage.
“Ha! This old man is protesting, demanding the return of the Filolial egg that was confiscated!”
“What…? Are you really doing something so terrible? Return it immediately!”
Confiscating a Filolial-sama’s egg… and if you forcibly took it from the owner herself, that’s an unforgivable act of barbarism! A scoundrel like Takt deserves to be made an example of!
“Um… regarding that matter…”
The guard whispers to me, as if trying to avoid the issue.
“I believe the Filolial presented to the Spear Hero on Malty’s orders is the very egg this old man is testifying about.”
“What?!”
Is it because I wanted it?! Ugh… How should I get out of this one? No, there’s no doubt this old man knows a great deal about Fleon-chan. I absolutely must talk to him!
“I understand. Old man, come talk to me for a moment about the Filolial.”
I give the guard a sidelong glance and a signal, as if to say I’ll handle the persuasion, then push the old man’s back and lead him straight out through the castle gate toward the town below.
“Where do you think you’re taking me?! Hurry! Hurry up and give that child back to me…”
Ah, it’s true that I’ll have to explain the situation. I whisper to the old man.

“That egg has already hatched, and I’m currently in possession of it. I’d like you to come with me so I can show you the way. However… we’ll have to travel a bit, but it’s dangerous if we don’t keep this a secret.”
“You say that…”
“It’s flying… Filolial-sama.”
At my words, the old man fell silent. He must have realized I wasn’t lying.
